employees.profile_text: Senior Backend Engineer with 6.5 years of experience in the Java ecosystem. Led the migration of two enterprise monolithic applications to microservices architecture using Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud, and Apache Kafka for asynchronous transaction processing. Strong skills in relational databases (PostgreSQL, query tuning) and Docker containerization on AWS. Familiar with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Currently finishing a FinTech legacy maintenance project.

Backend and AI/Data Specialist with 4 years of experience. Expert in building high-performance RESTful services with FastAPI and integrating predictive models. Hands-on experience with data processing pipelines using Pandas, document vectorization with ChromaDB, and LLM workflow orchestration through LangChain. Has built a RAG-based document Q&A system for a retail analytics product. Finishing current project in October 2026.

Full-stack Software Engineer specializing in React and TypeScript. Led development of complex real-time analytical dashboards with Next.js, Redux Toolkit, and Tailwind CSS. Frequently integrates GraphQL and RESTful APIs with a focus on render performance and accessibility. Has 5 years of frontend leadership experience on logistics and retail portal projects.

DevOps and Cloud Engineer with 3.5 years of experience automating infrastructure with Terraform and managing Kubernetes clusters (EKS). Designed and maintained robust CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, ensuring security compliance in AWS cloud environments. Currently on bench after completing a Telco Cloud Migration project.

Data Engineer with 5.5 years of experience building scalable data pipelines (ETL/ELT). Designed real-time ingestion flows with Apache Kafka and PySpark, orchestrated by Apache Airflow, loading aggregated data into Snowflake data warehouses for large-volume analytical reporting. Expert in supply chain data modelling and financial transaction anomaly detection.

Senior .NET Developer with 7 years of experience on cloud-native architectures in Microsoft Azure. Expert in ASP.NET Core Web API, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Microsoft SQL Server databases. Implemented asynchronous services with Azure Service Bus and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) containers. Delivered 3 large insurance and banking projects.

Mobile Application Developer specializing in cross-platform development with Flutter and Dart. Launched and maintained 3 banking apps on Google Play and Apple App Store, implementing secure biometric authentication, payment gateway integrations, and offline data synchronization via SQLite. 4.5 years of mobile development experience in the financial sector.

Senior QA Automation Engineer focused on end-to-end and performance testing. Built testing frameworks from scratch in Python with Playwright and PyTest, integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Extensive experience in REST API testing and load testing with Apache JMeter. 6 years experience across FinTech and SaaS products. Currently on bench.

Frontend Developer with expertise in Angular (versions 14-17) and TypeScript. Designed reactive user interfaces using RxJS and modular standalone component architecture. Diligent in writing unit tests with Jest and optimizing page load performance. 3 years of experience on internal enterprise admin portals.

Software Architect and Backend Engineer with 8 years of enterprise experience. Designed complex integrations between ERP systems (SAP) and modern web platforms using Spring Boot and RabbitMQ messaging. Expert in relational data modelling on Oracle DB and horizontal scalability best practices. Available for tech lead or principal architect roles.

Machine Learning Engineer focused on Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Transformer models. Trained and fine-tuned entity extraction models from unstructured documents (medical and financial PDFs). Exposes models via GPU-accelerated FastAPI microservices. 4 years of experience in document AI and LLM fine-tuning with PyTorch and HuggingFace.

Systems and Backend Engineer specializing in Go (Golang) and low-latency distributed architectures. Implemented high-frequency gRPC microservices for e-commerce order processing, monitored with Prometheus and Grafana, orchestrated in Kubernetes. 5 years of Go experience. Currently on bench after completing a Retail Cloud Platform project.

Fullstack Developer focused on Vue.js 3 and the Node.js ecosystem. Developed customer portals with responsive design, state management via Pinia, and modular Express backends with MongoDB persistence. 3.5 years of experience building customer-facing applications in retail and insurance verticals.

Security Engineer and DevSecOps consultant with 7.5 years of experience auditing enterprise applications. Integrates automated vulnerability scanners (SAST/DAST) in CI/CD pipelines, implements OWASP Top 10 compliance, and audits cloud network security configurations. Python scripting for automated penetration testing and security reporting.

Senior PHP Developer specializing in the Laravel framework. Built marketing campaign automation modules with asynchronous processing queues on Redis and optimized MySQL databases. Extensive experience integrating third-party APIs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe). 4.5 years working on SaaS marketing automation platforms.

Analytics Engineer specializing in corporate data transformation with dbt and Google BigQuery. Converts complex business requirements into clean, optimized dimensional data models feeding executive dashboards in Tableau and PowerBI. 5 years of experience in data governance, data quality, and SQL-based analytics for financial services.

Embedded Software Engineer with experience developing firmware for industrial IoT devices. Programmed communication drivers and MQTT/CoAP protocols on Embedded Linux systems, ensuring low power consumption and encrypted telemetry transmission. 6 years of IoT and edge computing experience in energy and industrial automation sectors.

Native iOS Developer with 4 years of experience in Apple ecosystem application development. Proficient in SwiftUI, MVVM architecture, and asynchronous state management with Combine. Integrates Apple Pay payments and Keychain security services. Delivered mobile banking modernization projects with high-security compliance requirements.

Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with Google Cloud Professional certification. Implemented declarative infrastructure using Terraform on GCP (Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud SQL, IAM). Automates administrative tasks through Python scripts and CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. 3 years of cloud infrastructure experience.

Backend Engineer focused on Node.js and TypeScript for high-concurrency applications. Designed the architecture for live chat rooms and real-time notifications using WebSockets and Redis Pub/Sub clusters, capable of handling tens of thousands of simultaneous users. 5.5 years of experience in streaming video and social platforms.

project_roles.title: Senior Java Microservices Engineer
project_roles.description: We need an experienced backend engineer to lead migration of a massive monolithic banking system to Spring Boot microservices. The role involves decoupling existing services, implementing event-driven architectures through Apache Kafka for asynchronous financial flows, and orchestrating services in containers on AWS cloud infrastructure. Must have production experience with Spring Boot 3, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL, Docker, and AWS.

project_roles.title: Python AI and Backend Developer
project_roles.description: We need a Python developer to build a scalable FastAPI backend for an intelligent medical assistant. The ideal candidate has experience in medical text processing, vector semantic search through embedding databases, and connecting large language models to internal databases via RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). LangChain and ChromaDB experience highly valued.

project_roles.title: Data Platform and Streaming Engineer
project_roles.description: Enterprise project for developing a real-time financial transaction analytics platform. The candidate will build low-latency processing flows through Apache Kafka and PySpark, orchestrated by Airflow, storing aggregated data in a Snowflake warehouse for payment anomaly detection. Data engineering expertise and financial domain knowledge required.

project_roles.title: Senior .NET Azure Cloud Specialist
project_roles.description: Development of the next generation insurance claims management portal on Microsoft Azure. The project requires advanced skills in ASP.NET Core, microservices architecture decoupled through Azure Service Bus, and high-availability SQL Server relational databases. DDD knowledge and cloud-native patterns essential.

project_roles.title: Senior React and TypeScript Frontend Lead
project_roles.description: Building the responsive web interface for an international retail giant. Requires solid experience in React 18, Next.js with server-side rendering, predictable state management, and smooth product catalog integration through optimized GraphQL queries. Must lead a team of 2 junior frontend engineers.

project_roles.title: DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Architect
project_roles.description: Modernization of critical infrastructure for a telecommunications company. The role involves fully automating resource provisioning through reusable Terraform modules on AWS, configuring production-grade Kubernetes EKS clusters, and securing CI/CD pipelines with DevSecOps practices. Security certification preferred.

project_roles.title: Mobile Engineer — Cross-Platform Flutter
project_roles.description: Upgrade of the banking mobile app suite for individual and corporate clients. Deep knowledge of Flutter and Dart required, along with biometric authentication integration with high financial security standards and offline data synchronization. Experience with banking-grade security (certificate pinning, jailbreak detection) is a strong plus.

project_roles.title: Lead QA Automation Engineer
project_roles.description: Creating a unified automated testing framework for the cloud services of an international fintech. The candidate will implement end-to-end test suites in Python with Playwright, load tests with Apache JMeter, and integrate them into release pipeline quality gates. Must be able to mentor junior QA engineers and define testing strategy.
